Rahul Gandhi's Call Allegedly Prevents Leader Joining BJP

A political leader named Rahul Bondre reportedly changed his decision not to join the BJP after receiving a phone call from Rahul Gandhi. This development is described as a shift in the political game in Maharashtra. The specific details of the conversation or the exact timing of the call were not provided in the coverage.
